name: statusline
description: A Claude Code status line with no config file: model, effort, git branch, and context / weekly / 5-hour usage that only appear once they get high

enabled.title: Status line
enabled.description: Keep this status line set in your settings.json. Off removes it (only if it is this one)

usageFrom.title: Show usage from (%)
usageFrom.description: Context and usage stay hidden below this percent, then show in white. 0 = always show

yellowFrom.title: Yellow from (%)
yellowFrom.description: Context and usage turn yellow from this percent

orangeFrom.title: Orange from (%)
orangeFrom.description: Context and usage turn orange from this percent

redFrom.title: Red from (%)
redFrom.description: Context and usage turn red from this percent

showEffort.title: Show effort
showEffort.description: Effort level as an arrow next to the model (low ↓, medium –, high ↑, xhigh ↑+, max M, auto a)

showContext.title: Show context
showContext.description: Percent of the context window used (hidden below "Show usage from", like usage)

showBranch.title: Show git branch
showBranch.description: Current git branch (hidden outside a git repo)

showResets.title: Show reset timers
showResets.description: Time until each usage window resets, next to its percent
